title: HtmlInputDatetimeLocal
responsibility: Renders the native input control with type datetime-local without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlInputDatetimeLocal.children
inputs.description: Optional Snippet prop that the script destructures out of the forwarded attributes and the markup never renders, so passing it changes nothing in the rendered input.

outputs.name: HtmlInputDatetimeLocal
outputs.description: The native input element rendered through svelte:element with the tag input, receiving every prop except children as attributes, with type set to datetime-local after the spread so that any passed type is overridden. No wrapper element is added and no child content is rendered.
